title: Input schema of the Stock Status Monitor for Luxury Goods Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Luxury retailer URLs to monitor for inventory updates.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of products to monitor.

monitoredBrands.title: Monitored Brands
monitoredBrands.description: Luxury brands to monitor (e.g., Hermès, Rolex, Louis Vuitton).

monitoredProducts.title: Monitored Product Categories
monitoredProducts.description: Product categories to focus on (e.g., Handbags, Watches, Jewelry).

stockAlertThreshold.title: Stock Alert Threshold
stockAlertThreshold.description: Alert when stock falls below this number of items.

priceRange.title: Price Range (Min - Max)
priceRange.description: Filter products by price range in USD.

enableNotifications.title: Enable Notifications
enableNotifications.description: Send alerts when stock changes are detected.

notificationEmail.title: Notification Email
notificationEmail.description: Email address to receive stock alerts.
